setup_workspace

cp $WORK/grove-toml .grove.toml
cp $WORK/gitignore .gitignore
exec git add .grove.toml .gitignore
exec git commit -m 'add grove config and gitignore'

exec git checkout -b symlink-branch
mkdir $WORK/outside
symlink config -> $WORK/outside
exec git add config
exec git commit -m 'commit config symlink'

exec git checkout main
mkdir config normal
cp $WORK/dot-env config/data.txt
cp $WORK/dot-env normal/data.txt

exec grove add symlink-branch
stderr 'Created worktree at .*[/\\]symlink-branch'
stderr 'Skipping preserved file config[/\\]data\.txt: cannot create its directory in the worktree:'
exists ../symlink-branch/normal/data.txt
! exists $WORK/outside/data.txt

-- grove-toml --
[preserve]
directories = ["config", "normal"]

-- gitignore --
config/
normal/

-- dot-env --
SECRET=value
